protocol: keras_cnn_v1: tools/train_d1.py groupguard protocol, network swapped to keras.applications
training_views: identical inference-capable full+smart RGB; no annotation bbox crops
agtron: mandatory EXIF-oriented ROI; no white balance; never see number labels
selection: inner group validation macro-F1 then NLL then earliest epoch/grid order

arm_rationale.K1_control_frozen: control: same frozen-head grid as D1 groupguard (one full-batch AdamW step per epoch, <=40)
arm_rationale.K1_control_finetune: control: same fine-tune grid as D1 groupguard; checks Keras result ~ PyTorch D1_finetune
arm_rationale.K2_new_finetune: one new variable vs K1_control_finetune: 'mild' replaced by 'wbexp' (exposure_EV and linear_red_blue_gain_log widened to the medium values; geometry, noise, blur and JPEG stay mild). Reason: the 8 Oct evidence names strong colour cast as the D1 failure on rf_boos, and the medium arm confounded photometric strength with crop 0.5 and JPEG q30. Same backbone, lr, epochs, grid size.

rows: tools.train_baseline.load_rows(root); must be 3395 trainval images of 4 sources, 3 classes
views: tools.train_d1.prepare_views(root): full+smart 224 uint8 RGB; view logits averaged in training and prediction
outer_train: video_cap_mask(groups, paths, seed=20261006) & source != fold; holdout = every image of the fold source
tuning: seed 20261006 only; chosen config/epoch/temperature reused for seeds 20261006/20261007/20261008; refit on the whole fold train; holdout never used for any choice
seeding: keras.utils.set_random_seed(seed) + tf.config.experimental.enable_op_determinism(); numpy default_rng(seed) for batch order and augmentation (same call order as D1)

model.preprocessing: the backbone's own built-in Rescaling layer; views are fed as float32 0-255, no ImageNet mean/std and no second normalisation
model.head: one Dense(3) on the 576-d pooled feature (Keras default init)
model.batchnorm: running statistics frozen (backbone called with training=False); affine and conv weights trainable
model.loss: class-weighted cross entropy, weights n/(3*count) on the fit rows, weighted mean

metric: tools.train_baseline.fold_table + tools.compare_tabular.calibration via tools.summarize_runs.evaluate; primary = mean LOSO macro-F1 (mean of 4 folds, then mean +- std(ddof=1) over 3 seeds)

decision_rule.wins_if: mean LOSO macro-F1 (mean over 3 seeds) > B1

export: only for an arm that beats B1: tf2onnx FP32, max |dp| vs Keras < 1e-5 and identical labels, then notebook p95
deviations: inner groups: the original cache/qa_audit_20261008/inner_groups.json was not available on this machine; regenerated with tools.qa_audit (results/qa_audit_regen_20261011, same policy and thresholds, 4-source manifest). Cannot be verified identical to the 8 Oct file.

manifest.csv was rebuilt from the 4 source zips (no rf_hendi); per-source/label counts match results/manifest_summary.json but the original manifest sha256 is not reproduced, so view pixels cannot be verified byte-identical to D1's.
compute: TensorFlow has no native-Windows GPU build after 2.10 and WSL2 is not installed, so everything runs on CPU.
K1 uses Keras ImageNet weights and the backbone's built-in preprocessing, which differ from torchvision's; K1 controls the protocol, it is not a weight-identical replica of D1.
a --smoke-limit code check on a small subsample ran after this plan was written and before the real run; its outputs live outside results/ and were not used for any choice.
limits: LOSO source-level convenience dataset; no Pi/E2E/frozen-test claim; every arm run is reported
